title: Acme Ordering Flows

header.label: Sunridge Partners · Internal · Draft
header.meta: 21 October 2026 · Author · Ordering app live since Mon 12 Oct (invented example)
header.lead_html: Before, each order was typed by hand 2 times and its date was lost in 2 places. With the ordering app, stock is checked every 15 minutes and a person keys the ERP once. Clerk and lead effort drops from ~20 to ~8 hours a week (estimate).

views.label: Before
views.say: Before: every order was retyped into the ERP and the plan spreadsheet, from a stock report up to a day old.

views.label: After
views.say: After: the app re-reads the ERP every 15 minutes and never writes to it; a person keys the ERP once.

views.label: Before
views.say: Before: six hand steps, and any change sent steps 2 to 6 back to be redone.

views.label: After
views.say: After: the app checks stock and drafts each route; people confirm, key and send.
views.rule: Rule: no stock OK, no place on the plan.
